<ApiTitle method="get" title="Download Deliverable Source File" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/deliverable/file/{deliverableId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}

Downloads the generated document in its source format, a Word (.docx) or PowerPoint (.pptx) file, as an attachment. Your plan must include file downloads.
